[EVENT] User is looking for advice on flea and tick prevention for Max.  
[EVENT] User ordered a 3-month supply of Frontline from 1800PetMeds on January 20th for $49.99 with free shipping.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for applying Frontline effectively:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Read the instructions carefully.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ensure the correct product for Max's weight range and species.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use the entire contents of the pipette or tube.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Apply to the right spot, usually between the shoulder blades.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Ensure Max's skin is dry before applying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Avoid applying on broken skin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Massage the product into the skin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Wait 24-48 hours before bathing or swimming.
